notes: «أخاه» with a name after it is one link: the name alone (rule 7).
The asked Imam is the last link, written as the report names him (owner ruling 2); the blessing is left out.
The second question («وَ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ») continues the same asker and Imam; no new chain.

«وَ سَأَلَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ أَخَاهُ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ» is rule 5: the asker is a link, then the one asked (the Imam, named in the words after the chain); «أخاه» is dropped; the second question «وَ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ» has no isnad of its own and is left out
